name: Thandiwe Nkosi
bio:
Thandiwe's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years of running a successful auto body repair shop in Johannesburg, she was approached by a local racing team impressed by her meticulous attention to detail and colour-matching skills. Initially hesitant, she soon fell in love with the precision and artistry demanded by motorsport paintwork.

Her approach is rooted in a deep understanding of paint chemistry and application techniques. She's known for her ability to create custom finishes that are not only visually stunning but also aerodynamically advantageous. She insists on using only the highest quality materials and meticulously inspects every surface to ensure flawless execution.

What sets Thandiwe apart is her innovative use of colour and texture to create unique designs. She constantly experiments with new techniques and is always pushing the boundaries of what's possible with automotive paint. Thandiwe is also a keen mentor to younger technicians, passing on her years of knowledge and experience.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled afro with subtle grey streaks
physical.description: A woman of strong build, Thandiwe carries herself with a quiet confidence and always wears her signature safety glasses pushed up on her forehead.

quirks: Always hums traditional Zulu songs while working.
Has a collection of miniature spray guns she keeps in her locker.
Insists on brewing a strong pot of rooibos tea every afternoon.
